text: クチバ　みなとの　サントアンヌ　ごうの　パーティ　パパと　いったぜ　いいだろー！

structure.jp: クチバ　みなとの　サントアンヌ　ごうの　パーティ
structure.en: the party on the S.S. Anne at Vermilion Harbor

patterns.name: 〜だろう
patterns.explanation: だろう at the end asks the listener to agree, like 'right?'. Here it is drawn out as だろー in a bragging tone. いいだろー = 'pretty great, huh?'

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ is a rough, boyish ending that adds a cocky push to what you say. いったぜ = 'I went, you know!'
